description: This file defines a custom HTML element 'cc-autocomplete' that provides autocomplete functionality, including rendering options, handling user input, fetching data from a specified endpoint, and managing UI interactions.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: A custom HTML element that provides autocomplete functionality with dynamic data fetching, rendering, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Autocomplete element, sets up DOM structure, event listeners, and default configurations.

methods.name: setupEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the data endpoint for fetching autocomplete suggestions based on element attributes.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input value and display text for the autocomplete component.

methods.name: removeActive
methods.description: Removes the 'active' class from a list of option elements.

methods.name: addActive
methods.description: Adds the 'active' class to a specific option in the list based on current focus, and scrolls it into view.

methods.name: createOption
methods.description: Creates and appends an option element to the suggestions list based on data.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Adjusts the position of the suggestions dropdown relative to the input field.
